evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` to fix transaction omission during block rescans.
rationale: Fixes a silent correctness bug where block rescans fail to detect transactions and report incorrect balances. When a transaction paying to an address outside the initial look-ahead pool precedes a pool-expanding transaction within the same block, the earlier transaction is skipped without warning during `rescanblockchain`, `importdescriptors`, or `restorewallet`.
